message.content: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","agent_id":"researcher","description":"Search academic and reputable industry sources (peer‑reviewed papers, NREL, IEA, recent review articles, manufacturer datasheets, and reputable news/industry sites) and compile a concise research_summary.md (approx. 2–3 pages) that covers: typical efficiencies by major technologies (monocrystalline, polycrystalline, thin‑film, perovskite), record lab vs real‑world efficiencies, key factors affecting efficiency (temperature, angle, shading, soiling, degradation), recent trends and breakthroughs, typical ranges for residential/commercial systems, and a reference list with URLs and one‑sentence annotations for each source.","dependencies":[],"produces":"research_summary.md","consumes":[],"rationale":"gathers authoritative evidence for the report","needs_tools":["web_search"]},{"id":"s2","agent_id":"orchestrator","kind":"meeting","attendees":["researcher","creative","data_analyst"],"description":"Chair a standup meeting to review research_summary.md (use review_artifacts), discuss and agree the report's angle, target audience, and a 3‑section outline; record the agreed decision and outline into agreed_angle.md (use record_decision). Meeting should capture chosen angle, target audience, 3-section outline, and any follow-up data tasks.","dependencies":["s1"],"produces":"agreed_angle.md","consumes":["research_summary.md"],"rationale":"aligns team on the report angle before writing","needs_tools":[]},{"id":"s3","agent_id":"creative","description":"Using research_summary.md and agreed_angle.md, write final_report.md: a polished markdown report following the agreed outline (include executive summary, key findings, recommendations, citations/URLs, and placeholders for any figures or tables); ensure tone and length match the agreed target audience and include an estimated reading time.","dependencies":["s2"],"produces":"final_report.md","consumes":["research_summary.md","agreed_angle.md"],"rationale":"produces the consumer-facing markdown report","needs_tools":["read_file","write_file"]}]}
